messages:
maria: Heads-up — night handoff for the kernel+quant bundle is in ~40m (23:40 UTC). I'm going to start the brief checklist now.

vince: ACK. I'm on monitoring and can own rollback if we see perf signals.

maria: Quick checklist:
- verify build checksum on nodes
- confirm kernel ABI matches runtime (no soft-fallbacks)
- staged traffic slice = 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%
- release notes link: https://redwood.internal/ops/release/7423 (draft)

kelly: If deploybot flips to sticky-pin, we should abort and roll to previous bundle. Agreed rollback triggers:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m
- p50 latency increase > 35% vs baseline for 5m
- token-per-request cost spike (KV cache miss > 20%)

oz: adding thermal/oom watch: GPU mem pressure > 90% on >10% hosts -> immediate slice rollback.

deploybot: deploy scheduled by maria at 2026-03-21T23:40:00Z to pool:night-quant. preflight checks: checksum ok, configs match, canary slice ready.

maria: Preflight note: local canaries passed on staging with quantized matmul v3. Watch for mismatch between float32 and int8 logits. We saw tiny rounding diffs but within eval thresholds.

vince: My dashboard is pinned to the new release's trace id. I'll call for rollback early if traces show tail latency regressions even if p50 looks fine.

kelly: Release-note blurb updated with known delta: "minor decoding distribution shift observed in constrained prompts; parity tests pass for our canned evals." Keep customer-facing text minimal.

maria: Deployment command when ready:
```
deploybot deploy --bundle night-quant-7423 --slice 2% --steps 2,10,50,100 --notify @eng-oncall
```

oz: I'll run the thermal sweep 10m before deploy and again at canary step. If any host crosses 85% mem, hold and drain that host from pool.

vince: One more ops rule: if rollback happens, do NOT auto-retry. Manual investigation first, then optionally redeploy prior bundle with `--force` after approvals.

maria: Agreed. Post-deploy chores: update release notes with final perf numbers, tag the commit, and ping CS + SRE.

kelly: I'm leaving my phone on. Ping me on-call if deploybot signals sticky-pin or sustained >1% errors. :phone: :thumbsup:

maria: OK launching to slice 2% in ~10m. I'll post quick status updates here.

deploybot: deploy step started: slice 2% -> 2026-03-21T23:49:30Z. preflight duration 18s.

vince: Saw small p95 bump ~10s after cutover, watching.

maria: If that stabilizes in the next 3m, we'll move to 10%. If not, rollback and collect traces.

deploybot: canary metrics @2%: errors 0.12%, p50 +8%, p95 +14%. next step pending approval.

maria: I want one more minute of stable traces then advance.

vince: advance from me.

kelly: advance on my side.

deploybot: advancing to 10% -> 2026-03-21T23:55:12Z.

maria: Keep eyes on KV cache hit-rate — we saw a config mismatch on a prior rollout that killed hit-rate. If KV miss >15% for 5m -> rollback.

oz: thermal good at 10%. no host above 80%.

deploybot: metrics @10%: errors 0.18%, p50 +9%, p95 +16%, kv_miss 6%. Next step scheduled.

vince: Looks stable; moving to 50% if no spike.

maria: pushing to 50% now.

deploybot: advancing to 50% -> 2026-03-22T00:03:44Z.

vince: saw a cluster with p95 +28% at 50% for 2m, but it decayed back down. Not triggering rollback yet. Traces indicate some longer decode loops on a small subset.

maria: okay hold at 50% for 10m and collect those traces. If recurrence, we roll back.

kelly: logging incident doc ID: IR-7423 to capture traces + who touched what.

maria: final note: after full rollout, we'll run a small eval suite against prod prompts to ensure no drift in customer critical intents. If any regression above 2% in eval score, we will flag a quality rollback.

deploybot: rollout complete -> 100% at 2026-03-22T00:18:02Z. post-deploy smoke checks passed.

vince: monitoring steady at 100% for 6m. p50 +7%, p95 +12%, errors 0.15% — within agreed thresholds.

maria: Great job team. I'll finalize release notes and tag the bundle. Leaving this thread open for 24h for any late regression reports.

kelly: I'll notify CS and drop the public-safe blurb.

oz: I'll schedule a short postmortem in 48h to look at the small tail blip.

maria: thanks everyone. :tada:
